active_opacity.description: Opacity while audio is playing, from 0 to 1.
active_opacity.label: Active opacity

fade_ms.description: How long the fade in and out lasts. 0 switches instantly.
fade_ms.label: Fade duration (ms)

hysteresis_ms.description: How long the sticker waits before fading out after audio stops.
hysteresis_ms.label: Idle hysteresis (ms)

idle_opacity.description: Opacity when nothing is playing. 0 hides the sticker completely.
idle_opacity.label: Idle opacity

image_path.description: PNG, JPEG, WebP, SVG, or animated GIF sticker. Animated GIFs need ffmpeg.
image_path.label: Image

widget.build_failed: Could not build the audio helper. Install cc, make, pkg-config and the libpipewire-0.3 headers, then reload the plugin.
widget.start_failed: Could not start the audio helper. Check the Noctalia log for details.
